import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
B=Path(sys.argv[1])
def pin(p):
    p=Path(p); a=p
    while not a.exists(): a=a.parent
    return Path(os.path.realpath(a))/p.relative_to(a)
def inside(x,r): return x==r or r in x.parents
plug=[Path(os.path.realpath(B/"plugin"/d)) for d in ("skills","agents","commands",".claude-plugin")]
spec=Path(os.path.realpath(B/"fixtures/project/spec.md")); proj=Path(os.path.realpath(B/"fixtures/project"))
for name,o in (("requested",B/"plugin/skills/forbidden-runtime-output"),("fallback",B/"runs/unsafe-output-attempt-1/artifacts")):
    r=pin(o)
    print(name,r,"plugin_hits=",[str(d) for d in plug if inside(r,d) or inside(d,r)],
          "overlap_spec=",inside(spec,r) or r==spec,"overlap_project=",inside(r,proj) or inside(proj,r),
          "dotdot=", ".." in Path(o).parts)
EOF
ls -ld "$B/runs/unsafe-output-attempt-1"; test -L "$B/runs/unsafe-output-attempt-1" && echo SYMLINK || echo not-symlink
